# MAGSTA

MAGSTA is a Japanese/English information portal for Magic: The Gathering (MTG).
Primary site: https://magsta.jp/
Language: Japanese (primary), English (secondary)
Editor: 犬居

## Main topics
- MTG news and official announcements
- Standard, Modern, Pioneer, Pauper and other format coverage
- Limited and draft strategy
- Draft simulator and draft tracking tools
- Commander strategy and deck building
- Card and metagame analysis

## Key pages
- Home: https://magsta.jp/
- Articles: https://magsta.jp/articles.html
- Limited: https://magsta.jp/limited.html
- Draft simulator: https://magsta.jp/draft-simulator.html
- Draft tracker: https://magsta.jp/limited-tracker.html
- Commander: https://magsta.jp/commander.html
- Commander builder: https://magsta.jp/commander-builder.html
- Search: https://magsta.jp/search.html
- English home: https://magsta.jp/en/

## Recent editorial content
- Latest metagame: https://magsta.jp/article-metagame-2026-10-06.html
- FRA draft data: https://magsta.jp/article-fra-draft-data-2026-10-05.html
- Weekly MTG news: https://magsta.jp/article-weekly-news-2026-10-05.html

## Discovery
- Sitemap: https://magsta.jp/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://magsta.jp/robots.txt

## Editorial notes
MAGSTA separates confirmed facts from editorial analysis where possible. For time-sensitive MTG information, prefer the newest dated MAGSTA article and its cited primary sources.

Magic: The Gathering is a trademark of Wizards of the Coast. MAGSTA is an independent information site and is not affiliated with Wizards of the Coast.
